m.aarti.tek: This is the āratī of Śrī Vṛṣabhānu's darling daughter, the bud of the root that is being, consciousness and bliss.
m.aarti.pad1: Destroyer of fear, who carries across the ocean of worldly existence; remover of sin, suffering, the Kali age and impurity; who sports in Goloka, the divine abode — this is the āratī of the protector of her people, the good mother of the world.
m.aarti.pad2: Bringer of joy to the whole universe, all-auspicious, giver of every blessing, giver of love for the feet of Nanda's son — this is the āratī of her who plays joyously in the nectar-sweet rasa of love.
m.aarti.pad3: Ever full of bliss, the giver of delight; who adorns the bliss of Kṛṣṇa, who is bliss itself; full of rasa, who maddens the mind full of rasa — this is the āratī of the lotus full of sweetness for Kṛṣṇa the bee.
m.aarti.pad4: Eternal queen of the bowers, sovereign queen; the form of supreme love, the supreme goddess; refuge of the hosts of gopīs, queen of the gopīs — this is the āratī of her who is a garland of pure and wondrous bhāvas (feelings of love).
